sections.title: Describing Cultural Sanctuaries and Historic Bulwarks
sections.content: You know *-ként* ('as') from A2 Unit 36. It also says in what role a person became known: *Károli Gáspár a Biblia fordítójaként*, *Szenczi Molnár Albert a zsoltárok fordítójaként*. The table lists this lesson's new words.

items.spanish: Károli Gáspár a Biblia fordítójaként lett híres.
items.english: Gáspár Károli became famous as the translator of the Bible.
The Vizsoly Bible was printed in 1590.

items.spanish: Szenczi Molnár Albert a genfi zsoltárok fordítójaként ismert.
items.english: Albert Szenczi Molnár is known as the translator of the Genevan psalms.
